name: Furukawa Co.,Ltd.
summary: Furukawa Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells machinery, metals, electronics, and chemical products Japan and internationally. It operates through Industrial Machinery, Rock Drills, Unique, Metals, Electronics, Chemical Products, and Real Estate segments.
